name: List All Inventory Locations
description: Returns all inventory locations that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the inventory location

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter inventory locations last updated at or after this date-time

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the inventory location

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the inventory location

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief summary or description of the inventory location

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date and time the inventory location was last updated

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the inventory location

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
